auto_failback.description: Automatically fail resources back to original node when it recovers

deadtime_interval.description: Seconds to wait before declaring a node dead

debug_mode.description: Enable verbose debug logging (not recommended for production)

interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to broadcast heartbeats on (e.g., ['eth0', 'bond0'])

peers.description: List of unicast peer nodes (for non-broadcast environments)

address.description: IP address of the peer node

initdead_interval.description: Seconds to wait on initial startup before assuming peers are dead

keepalive_interval.description: Seconds between heartbeat packets (must be < deadtime)

facility.description: Syslog facility to use (e.g., local0, daemon)

logfile.description: Path to log file (empty string disables file logging)

nodes.description: Explicit list of all nodes in the cluster (required for >2 nodes or non-standard names)

enabled.description: Enable Pacemaker resource manager (CRM) support (deprecated in Heartbeat 3+)

use_logd.description: Enable external logd daemon (recommended for large deployments)

warntime_interval.description: Seconds before declaring a node in warning state

device.description: Watchdog device path (e.g., /dev/watchdog); leave empty to disable
